programme.title: From Island Farms to Cloud Power, From Mountain Hubs to Urban Beats
programme.desc: From tropical coffee aromas to high-tech computing hubs, how is China defining "high-quality development"? In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the fields of Wanning, Hainan, where a small coffee bean becomes a symbol of the Free Trade Port’s opening-up, to the mountains of Guizhou, where a 14-millisecond data latency is powering the rendering of global blockbusters like Ne Zha 2. Finally, we dive into the vibrant Livehouse scene of China’s megacities, exploring a $1.2 billion "emotional economy" that is reshaping urban nightlife. From solid digital infrastructure to the rhythmic energy of the music scene, this episode captures the heartbeat of China’s evolving economic future.

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc: From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances. The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: APEC China 2026 – Unlocking New opportunities for the Asia-Pacific
programme.desc: Leaders and representatives from 21 member economies of APEC gather in Shenzhen, China for the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting. CGTN Biztalk host Michael Wang talks to senior researchers, analysts and business insiders to discuss how APEC can advance free trade and forge new consensus on artificial intelligence and supply chain resilience, decode how APEC China Year can chart a course for stronger, more cohesive regional cooperation that will shape the economic landscape for the years to come.

programme.title: Mexican entrepreneur builds a China-Latin America trade bridge in the Greater Bay Area
programme.desc: Fernanda, an entrepreneur from Mexico, has launched a trade services platform in the Greater Bay Area to help Latin American companies enter the Chinese market. For her, APEC is not just a concept on paper-it is part of her everyday work, from business negotiations to cross-border partnerships. Her team also helps Chinese companies explore Latin American markets, creating new opportunities for shared growth across the Asia-Pacific.

programme.title: APEC Selfies: An Australian entrepreneur is taking AI beyond the screen. What's next?
programme.desc: From interactive smart bins to public installations that respond to emotions, Australian product designer and Sencity co-founder Steven Bai is exploring how AI can be integrated into streets, buildings and public spaces - taking technology beyond screens and into everyday life. From conceiving his startup idea to putting down roots in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, he is drawing on China's well-developed manufacturing ecosystem to bring Physical AI innovations to global markets. #APECChina2026 #APECChinaYear

programme.title: China through the eyes of CanCham Chair
programme.desc: For Dr. Mark Ceolin, Shanghai is more than a gateway to China and the Asia-Pacific - it is where his personal journey and China-Canada connections took root. Having witnessed the city’s remarkable rise since the 2000s, he has dedicated himself to helping Canadian companies grow in China. Seeing is believing. Today, Mark guides a growing number of Canadian businesses to experience a welcoming market full of emerging possibilities.

programme.title: APEC Selfies | Brewing bridges: A Filipino entrepreneur's cross-border dream
programme.desc: What happens when a Filipino coffee lover turns his passion into a business in China? Meet Diel, founder of Nearby Coffee in Quanzhou, Fujian Province, who is serving up more than just a good brew! He's building cultural connections between China and the Philippines, with plans to take his business across borders. #APECChina2026 #APECChinaYear

programme.title: RAZOR: Shocking the System: Why China is Winning the EV Race
programme.desc: China now produces two out of every three electric vehicles sold worldwide. How did this transformation of the global auto industry happen so fast, and what does it mean for once-dominant European carmakers? Is it an unfair advantage or simply smart strategising? Jen Copestake presents Shocking the System: Why China is winning the EV race—a documentary that takes you inside China's EV revolution. We explore the supply chain dominance that's slashed production costs, and the 'Corner Overtaking' strategy that has helped Chinese automakers leapfrog their global competitors.

programme.title: RAZOR: Rise of the Humanoids
programme.desc: China's humanoid robot revolution is no longer science fiction. It is unfolding right now. From Shenzhen's first robot 6S store to advanced research labs in Shanghai, we meet the pioneers building machines that can walk, talk, fold laundry, stock supermarket shelves, and even box. Featuring insights from Dr Liu Shaoshan, Unitree Robotics, and AgiBot, this episode explores embodied AI, robotic hands with human-like touch, and the race to bring humanoids into factories and eventually into our homes. The question is no longer if they will enter our world, but when.

programme.title: BizPodcast: Why are global entrepreneurs choosing Shenzhen?
programme.desc: What makes Shenzhen such an attractive place to launch a business? With the 2026 APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting approaching, all eyes are on this innovation-driven city in China. But beyond its reputation as a tech hub, what does it actually take to turn a big idea into a real product here? In this episode of #BizPodcast, CGTN talks with two entrepreneurs about why they chose Shenzhen, how they bring ideas to market, and what young founders should know before starting a business. Would you consider starting a business in Shenzhen? What would you want to know first?

programme.title: Vive la Tech: Climate change is changing French wine
programme.desc: CGTN's new special program "Vive La Tech" focuses on some of the coolest science collaborations between China and France. In this episode, we shift our attention to climate change and the grape at risk. Follow our reporter Yang Zhao into the vineyards.

programme.title: Vive La Tech: Approaching the limits of temperature measurement
programme.desc: In this episode of CGTN's special program "Vive La Tech," we dive into the "frozen world". In low-temperature metrology, scientists created the world's most precise temperature measuring device, from 5 to 24.5 kelvin, providing a source for all thermometers around the world. Join CGTN reporter Yang Zhao to explore how such an innovative partnership can open new doors for fundamental science.

programme.title: Guangdong Expands Opening Up to Connect with Asia-Pacific
programme.desc: Guangdong Province has long been one of China's pioneers in opening up. As the country's leading provincial trader, Guangdong is deepening economic ties with the Asia-Pacific through trade, innovation and closer cooperation. From coffee machines made in Shunde to robots developed through Guangdong-Hong Kong collaboration, companies are finding new opportunities across the region. The province has been China's largest provincial trader for 40 years, with last year's imports and exports topping 9 trillion yuan (about 1.3 trillion US dollars) and more than 20 million market entities. Shunde is now the world's largest coffee machine production base, with Gemilai alone shipping to over 60 countries and selling more than two million units. Leveraging the Greater Bay Area's innovation hub, Guangdong is also advancing Guangdong-Hong Kong robotics projects and, as Shenzhen hosts APEC this year, aims to deepen regional industrial and supply-chain links for shared growth.

programme.title: Shared Future for Asia Pacific: Best-selling hair dryer highlights strengths of southern China's cross-border supply chain
programme.desc: As China hosts APEC 2026, regional integration is taking center stage. In southern China's Greater Bay Area, cities like Zhuhai, Hengqin, and Macao are operating like a single supply chain network, linking automated factories with global talent and capital. To see how this cross-border teamwork helps brands go global, CGTN's Yu Hongyu takes us inside a hair dryer factory in Zhuhai.

programme.title: Shenzhen empowers Asia-Pacific with new quality productive forces
programme.desc: Once a fishing town, Shenzhen is now a city where emerging technologies move quickly from concept to daily life. Our reporter Wang Tianyu explores what powers that transformation. Take a look.

programme.title: From bikes to your phone: Carbon fiber weaves the Asia-Pacific
programme.desc: Carbon fiber-once reserved for aerospace and elite racing-is now powering a much broader industrial shift across the Asia-Pacific. In southern China, Guangdong province is turning lower-cost mass production into a major export advantage. CGTN's Yu Hongyu explores how this featherlight thread is is driving billions in APEC trade.

programme.title: OFFSHORE WIND Powers the Asia-Pacific
programme.desc: You flip a switch, and the lights come on. But where does that power come from? In Yangjiang, Guangdong, the answer lies offshore. The city leads all of China's prefecture-level cities in offshore wind capacity, backed by a growing industrial chain spanning turbine manufacturing, testing and operations. CGTN reporter Yu Bokun takes you inside China's offshore wind industry and explores how it is helping power the Asia-Pacific's green transition.

programme.title: From receptionist to manager: Elizabeth's 8-year journey at a Chinese firm
programme.desc: Elizabeth Lindon, a 46-year-old from Papua New Guinea, is now a senior supervisor at BNBM PNG in Port Moresby. Over eight years, she has worked her way up from office receptionist to forklift operator--breaking the stereotype that operating forklifts is "a man's job"--and then moving into management. Her journey shows how China-APEC cooperation translates into real benefits for individuals and families. CGTN presents a special series on the role of China's centrally administered SOEs in the Asia-Pacific, in collaboration with China's State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC). The series explores their contributions to regional connectivity, green transition, the digital economy, industrial cooperation and people's livelihoods, with insights on building a shared future for the region. #APECChina2026 #APECChinaYear

programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

Qingdao: The Jade Island
programme.desc: To boost Qingdao's international‑oriented publicity and build its profile as an international tourist city, this episode takes us to Qingdao. programme.title: Between Heaven and Earth : Traveling Through Grasslands Ep.2
programme.desc: The first season of the "Wandering the World" series follows a traveler across six of China's greatest grasslands, revealing the natural beauty of their epic landscapes and the distinctive lives of the people who inhabit them.

programme.title: Jingdezhen Handmade Porcelain
programme.desc: Porcelain has shaped the culture of the whole world. The wisdom behind each of 72 procedures has been refined from generation to generation. The times may change, some techniques may change, but what remains the same is the burning flame of the kiln that keeps setting so many hearts on fire for this ancient craft.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: Aerial China IV: Xizang
programme.desc: A world-renowned wonderland of snow-capped peaks and river sources, Xizang is also a land of tradition, deep culture and spirituality. However, Xizang also has plenty to boast of in terms of its natural history and wonders. So join us as we fly over the roof of the world to survey the plateau where Tibetan antelopes, wild yaks and people live in harmony!

programme.title: Village Voyage: Before the icon Bruce Lee, there was Shunde in Foshan
programme.desc: Nunchucks. Dark shades. A yellow jumpsuit. That unmistakable nose wipe. Blinding punches and the snake feint - one name says it all: Bruce Lee, the man who brought Chinese martial arts to the world. But every legend has a beginning - and his is less well known. It started in Shunde of Foshan City, south China's Guangdong Province. Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots - following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

programme.title: Menu of the Seasons: Pure Brightness
programme.desc: This documentary showcases the seasonal ingredients and traditional customs of spring across China, highlighting the culinary wisdom, local flavors, and intangible cultural heritage tied to the country.

programme.title: Gourmets Alive II Ep.4
programme.desc: Literati such as Lu You, Li Yu, Yuan Mei, and Wang Zengqi take center stage as we explore their worlds and works through the flavors and cuisine of daily life.

programme.title: From Farm to Table (China-France Season) Ep.2
programme.desc: Set against the backdrop of the 60th anniversary of Sino-French diplomatic relations, this program focuses on the full-chain coordination mechanism that brings food from French farms to Chinese tables, capturing the collision and fusion of two great food cultures.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Taste of Home
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May eat their way down memory lane across virtual space and different time zones, and embark on a culinary journey at their birthplace. Eva rediscovers her love for a classic century-old dish in her hometown Vienna and introduces Austria's long-lasting coffeehouse culture to Tianran, who also joins her virtually for an evening with friends and food the traditional Viennese way. Meanwhile, Beijing's charming autumn season sets Tianran back in time as he rediscovers flavors from his childhood. His passion for tea might have even started in one of the old tea shops in Beijing's hutongs, recollecting his memories one sip at a time, accompanied by nostalgic meals and a relaxed stroll under yellow gingko trees.

programme.title: China Bound: Xiamen
programme.desc: What's it like in one of China's happiest cities? Tianran is in sunny Xiamen on China's southeast coast, visiting the city's famous "island of music" and sampling local delicacies like shark meatballs, shacha noodles and fish in "soy sauce water". He'll discover former fishing villages turned hipster havens, drink tea with locals beneath traditional tenement buildings, and visit a student enclave brimming with creative startup energy.

Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots - following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

programme.title: Menu of the Seasons: Pure Brightness
programme.desc: This documentary showcases the seasonal ingredients and traditional customs of spring across China, highlighting the culinary wisdom, local flavors, and intangible cultural heritage tied to the country.

programme.title: Gourmets Alive II Ep.4
programme.desc: Literati such as Lu You, Li Yu, Yuan Mei, and Wang Zengqi take center stage as we explore their worlds and works through the flavors and cuisine of daily life.

programme.title: From Farm to Table (China-France Season) Ep.2
programme.desc: Set against the backdrop of the 60th anniversary of Sino-French diplomatic relations, this program focuses on the full-chain coordination mechanism that brings food from French farms to Chinese tables, capturing the collision and fusion of two great food cultures.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Taste of Home
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May eat their way down memory lane across virtual space and different time zones, and embark on a culinary journey at their birthplace. Eva rediscovers her love for a classic century-old dish in her hometown Vienna and introduces Austria's long-lasting coffeehouse culture to Tianran, who also joins her virtually for an evening with friends and food the traditional Viennese way. Meanwhile, Beijing's charming autumn season sets Tianran back in time as he rediscovers flavors from his childhood. His passion for tea might have even started in one of the old tea shops in Beijing's hutongs, recollecting his memories one sip at a time, accompanied by nostalgic meals and a relaxed stroll under yellow gingko trees.

programme.title: China Bound: Xiamen
programme.desc: What's it like in one of China's happiest cities? Tianran is in sunny Xiamen on China's southeast coast, visiting the city's famous "island of music" and sampling local delicacies like shark meatballs, shacha noodles and fish in "soy sauce water". He'll discover former fishing villages turned hipster havens, drink tea with locals beneath traditional tenement buildings, and visit a student enclave brimming with creative startup energy.

programme.title: Qingdao: The Jade Island
programme.desc: To boost Qingdao's international‑oriented publicity and build its profile as an international tourist city, this episode takes us to Qingdao. Through three segments ‑ Modern Qingdao, Historic Qingdao and Internationalized Qingdao, we showcase the diverse facets of this charming city.

programme.title: Between Heaven and Earth : Traveling Through Grasslands Ep.2
programme.desc: The first season of the "Wandering the World" series follows a traveler across six of China's greatest grasslands, revealing the natural beauty of their epic landscapes and the distinctive lives of the people who inhabit them.

programme.title: Jingdezhen Handmade Porcelain
programme.desc: Porcelain has shaped the culture of the whole world. The wisdom behind each of 72 procedures has been refined from generation to generation. The times may change, some techniques may change, but what remains the same is the burning flame of the kiln that keeps setting so many hearts on fire for this ancient craft.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: Aerial China IV: Xizang
programme.desc: A world-renowned wonderland of snow-capped peaks and river sources, Xizang is also a land of tradition, deep culture and spirituality. However, Xizang also has plenty to boast of in terms of its natural history and wonders. So join us as we fly over the roof of the world to survey the plateau where Tibetan antelopes, wild yaks and people live in harmony!

programme.title: Tirador
programme.desc: Decidido a probar su inocencia en una traición, Bob Lee Swagger se encuentra ahora en una tensa carrera contra todas las fuerzas de la ley de los Estados Unidos y contra una organización oscura que quiere verlo muerto.

programme.title: Terminator 2: juicio final
programme.desc: La máquina no humana que domina la élite del futuro devastado por la guerra despacha un cíborg asesino al pasado para matar a un jovencito porque pronto será el líder de la resistencia en contra de la máquina.

programme.title: Terminator: Destino oculto
programme.desc: Un súper soldado mejorado se une a la combatiente Sarah Connor (Linda Hamilton) y un aliado inesperado (Arnold Schwarzenegger) para detener al Terminator más mortífero hasta el momento.

programme.title: La estafa maestra
programme.desc: Tras ser traicionados y abandonados a su suerte en Italia, Charlie Croker y su equipo planean un elaborado robo de oro contra su antiguo aliado.

programme.title: Terminator 2: juicio final
programme.desc: La máquina no humana que domina la élite del futuro devastado por la guerra despacha un cíborg asesino al pasado para matar a un jovencito porque pronto será el líder de la resistencia en contra de la máquina.

programme.title: La suburban dorada
programme.desc: Un policía judicial es acusado de estar relacionado con el narcotráfico sólo por ayudar a su primo. Las circunstancias lo convierten en un fugitivo de la ley y por recuperar a su hijo tiene que involucrase con el narco.

programme.title: 6 Horas: El final
programme.desc: Un joven tiene sólo seis horas para escapar con su mejor amigo de su ciudad natal antes de que explote un reactor nuclear.

programme.title: Contract Killers
programme.desc: Traicionado por aquellos en los que más confiaba, un asesino a sueldo novato del gobierno descubre que es el objetivo del asesino más peligroso del mundo y así comienza un despiadado juego de matar primero o morir.

programme.title: AVH: Alien vs. Hunter
programme.desc: Un cazador galáctico persigue a su presa más mortífera del universo.

programme.title: Cuestion de Honor
programme.desc: Un Ranger del Ejército se infiltra en una familia mafiosa haciéndose pasar por asesino a sueldo. Junto con su tío, traman una venganza contra los asesinos que mataron a toda su familia cuando él era joven.

programme.title: Choque Mortal
programme.desc: Una pareja de luna de miel en Marruecos sobrevive a un fatal accidente de coche en medio del desierto.

programme.title: El asesino de al lado
programme.desc: El arquitecto Jonathan se muda a un complejo de apartamentos con patio en Los Ángeles y luego uno de sus vecinos es asesinado por error. Jonathan era la víctima prevista.

programme.title: Problemas en el Paraiso
programme.desc: Rachel, una reciente viuda, viaja de regreso a Estados Unidos en un barco de carga con el cuerpo de su esposo cuando el barco naufraga en una isla desierta. Solo hay otro sobreviviente y ambos están decididos a ser rescatados. Tras una serie de eventos extremos, finalmente son encontrados, pero por su esposo, quien había fingido su muerte.

programme.title: Top Gunner
programme.desc: Los graduados de una remota base de las Fuerzas Aéreas estadounidenses deben proteger un arma biológica de edición genética de los militares rusos, que están desesperados por hacerse con el agente vírico a cualquier precio.

programme.title: H4zard
programme.desc: Sigue a Noah, quien realmente ama a su novia, a su hija y a su coche, pero después de aceptar un trabajo como conductor, se ve envuelto en una carrera que podría costarle la vida, su familia o su querido automóvil.

programme.title: Asesino de tiburones
programme.desc: Los servicios del asesino de tiburones Chase Walker han sido contratados por su hermano Jake, jefe de una banda criminal de la Costa Oeste. El trabajo: matar al tiburón de aleta negra que se tragó un valioso diamante durante una transacción entre bandas. Para vigilar a Chase, se alista a Jasmine, colega de Jake. Pero la relación entre Chase y Jasmine se profundiza con las amenazas de un jefe rival: llevarle el diamante o morir. Pronto, las lealtades cambiarán, y Chase aprenderá que confiar en la sangre es para tontos. Ahora, se enfrentan jefes contra jefes, hermanos contra hermanos y el hombre contra la naturaleza, mientras Chase se esfuerza por rescatar a Jasmine, salvar su propia vida y rastrear al gran tiburón de aleta negra que será el mayor desafío de su carrera.

programme.title: A ciegas
programme.desc: A police inspector has to solve two gruesome murders. The problem is, his only suspect is a blind man.

programme.title: Tren de Bala Abatido
programme.desc: En su viaje inaugural, el tren de alta velocidad más rápido del mundo está equipado con una bomba que explotará si desciende por debajo de las 200 mph.

programme.title: A través del ojo
programme.desc: 1976 es un año peligroso en el estrecho de Yucatán. Jack Hooks, un ex policía traicionado por su socio corrupto, es enviado a la cárcel por un delito relacionado con drogas que no cometió. Tras salir de prisión gracias a un acuerdo de libertad anticipada ofrecido por la DEA, se le asigna una misión de vida o muerte para acabar con el tráfico de drogas de su antiguo socio Frank Rossi y sus contactos.

programme.title: San Andreas Mega Seísmo
programme.desc: Los científicos hacen un horrible descubrimiento: El "Big One" se acerca en dos días, con él, California se hundirá en el océano. Su única esperanza es romper un volcán que desplace la energía del terremoto y construya una nueva corteza en la superficie. Pero a medida que las pretemblores convierten California en un caos, se trata de una carrera contrarreloj que los científicos podrían no ganar

programme.title: El Hombre del Presidente
programme.desc: Un agente secreto altamente clasificado del presidente de Estados Unidos debe encontrar un intrépido sustituto que se haga cargo de sus peligrosísimas misiones militares.

programme.title: Colapso Global
programme.desc: El caos reina en nuestro planeta, llueve fuego del cielo y las personas deben matar para sobrevivir. Un grupo de habitantes de Pleasent, Washington, liderados por el alcalde, busca un refugio en un lugar elevado. Mientras la Tierra empieza a quebrarse, entre avalanchas, volcanes y motines, la caravana se enfrenta a un viaje por carretera en un paisaje postapocalíptico que nunca olvidarán.

programme.title: Choque Mortal
programme.desc: Una pareja de luna de miel en Marruecos sobrevive a un fatal accidente de coche en medio del desierto.

programme.title: Eye of the beast: El monstruo del lago
programme.desc: Un joven científico llega a un pequeño pueblo pesquero para luchar contra la criatura que vive bajo el agua.

programme.title: Arenas movedizas
programme.desc: En este thriller negro, un banquero de carácter introvertido y trabajador se ve envuelto en una serie de eventos que incluyen un asesinato y una trama de chantaje, todo mientras intenta mantener su vida en orden.

programme.title: A través del ojo
programme.desc: 1976 es un año peligroso en el estrecho de Yucatán. Jack Hooks, un ex policía traicionado por su socio corrupto, es enviado a la cárcel por un delito relacionado con drogas que no cometió. programme.title: Los Piratas
programme.desc: Dios Ama el Caviar es la fascinante historia de IOANNIS VARVAKIS y su viaje desde humilde pirata griego hasta convertirse en millonario internacional del caviar, con la confianza de Catalina la Grande de Rusia. Sin embargo, su riqueza y poder no le otorgan satisfacción, y su ambición desmedida solo le trae sufrimiento, hasta que lo entrega todo, incluso a sí mismo, en nombre del amor. Esta epopeya, basada en la vida real de Varvakis, se desarrolla desde la isla griega de Psara hasta la corte de Catalina la Grande en Rusia y las orillas del mar Caspio, para luego regresar a Grecia, un país desgarrado por la guerra civil y la lucha por la independencia durante la Revolución de 1821 contra el Imperio Otomano.

programme.title: Thor: god of thunder (esp)
programme.desc: Loki, el malvado tío de Thor, ha escapado de Asgard en busca de Yggdrasil, el Árbol de los Nueve Reinos, un árbol que contiene el poder del universo y que está oculto en la Tierra.

programme.title: Tren de Bala Abatido
programme.desc: En su viaje inaugural, el tren de alta velocidad más rápido del mundo está equipado con una bomba que explotará si desciende por debajo de las 200 mph.

A principios del siglo XX, China se encuentra en crisis. El país está dividido en facciones enfrentadas, los ciudadanos pasan hambre y las recientes reformas políticas han empeorado la situación. La dinastía Qing, gobernada por un emperador de siete años y su despiadada madre, la emperatriz viuda Longyu, está completamente desconectada tras 250 años de poder incuestionable. Huang Xing acaba de regresar de Japón, donde estudió el arte de la guerra moderna. Al ver a su país desmoronarse, siente que no tiene otra opción que tomar las armas.

programme.title: Me case con un desconocido
programme.desc: Emma y David acaban de casarse. Durante su luna de miel, la joven es atacada salvajemente. Su extraño comportamiento y su negativa a cooperar hacen que David se convierta rápidamente en el principal sospechoso. Emma rechaza esta sugerencia, pero empieza a tener dudas: ¿conoce realmente al hombre con el que se ha casado?

programme.title: Yatterman
programme.desc: La hermosa y ultra sexy Doronjo y sus malvados esbirros, sedientos de dinero, fama y poder, intentan recuperar los pedazos de una legendaria piedra con poderes misteriosos. Pero sus planes se verán interrumpidos por Gan, Ai y su fiel perro robot gigante, quienes iniciarán una frenética carrera contrarreloj para impedir que la gema caiga en manos de los villanos.

programme.title: Catástrofe Helada
programme.desc: Es Navidad y la nieve cubre cada rincón de un apacible pueblo. Sin embargo, la tragedia empieza cuando un terrorífico meteorito se estrella y amenaza con dejar congelada a toda la población, convirtiendo la blanca Navidad en una pesadilla de hielo.

programme.title: Catástrofe en la Tierra
programme.desc: Después de un destello en el cielo, la Luna desaparece. Tras un segundo destello, nadie recuerda nada. Once meses después la Tierra se ha convertido en un lugar postapocalíptico, ya que fue absorbida por un agujero de gusano. Rodeados de catástrofes naturales constantes y sin forma alguna de civilización, los supervivientes deberán encontrar un lugar seguro donde volver a empezar.

programme.title: Exoplaneta Dune en Peligro
programme.desc: Una tripulación en misión para salvar una base abandonada en un planeta desértico se convierte en mortal cuando son acechados y atacados por los principales depredadores del planeta: gusanos de arena gigantes.

programme.title: If Looks Could Kill
programme.desc: Faith está orgullosa de ser por fin policía en su ciudad natal de Stillwater, Oklahoma. Se une a Paul, su antiguo amor, en el cuerpo de policía y se preocupa cuando él se involucra sentimentalmente con Jessica, una belleza errática con un pasado criminal. programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: In 1983, Navy seamen Sonny Grotton left base for a long weekend at home. But as he pulled into his driveway, a gunman killed him. And in 1993, former state trooper Doug Wright claimed his estranged wife shot and killed herself in their home.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: When Sherry Leighty goes missing in 1999, her family is left wondering how a dedicated mother of three could vanish without a trace. A decade later, the cold case heats up when Sherry's sister launches a social media campaign.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: 13 days after Pam Pitts disappears in 1988 her charred body is found at a popular hangout spot in the Arizona desert. When a second victim is discovered in a mineshaft, detectives suspect the killer may have known them both.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.sub-title: The Widow And The Wolf/Texas Drifter
programme.desc: After the murder of her aunt goes cold, a woman helps launch an advocate group that brings awareness to cases that have gone unsolved.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A high school janitor is suspected in the murder of a young girl, but with only circumstantial evidence to go on, police must let the case go cold. And a woman asks the police to reopen the 24-year-old case of her cousin's disappearance.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: From England to Texas to Georgia, I.R. will go inside cold case units and watch as police use ballistics testing, old fashioned fingerprints and a new DNA data bank for criminals, to crack open the mysteries of unsolved crimes.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: Investigators in Virginia, probing the murder case of a sailor, seek the help of a forensic anthropologist from the "body farm" in the Great Smoky Mountains. Dr. William Bass became an expert on the human body's rate of decay by watching bodies.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A district attorney uses a clever technique--a "John Doe indictment"--to give law enforcement officials the time they need to track down the Schoolgirl Rapist from Rochester, N. Y.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: In Cree culture, a promise is sacred. When Cree woman Shirley Soosay goes missing in 1980, her niece Violet promises her grandmother that she will bring Shirley home.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.sub-title: The Boy And The Monster/Secret In The Cellar
programme.desc: In Portland, Maine a housewife disappears. One year later her body is unearthed in the cellar. I.R. unravels this cold case investigation from the inside out. With the help of science, police are able to uncover a blueprint of the crime.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: When a schoolteacher is found murdered in her New Jersey apartment in the fall of 2009, suspicion is cast on her soon to be ex-husband. Long after the case goes cold, a detective embarks on a mission to help the man clear his name.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: When a woman is found murdered in her mobile home, police make two shocking discoveries--her husband may not only have been the killer, but he may have also killed his first wife 31 years before.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A new fingerprint identification system helps detectives track down a killer after three years of searching. And a Georgia investigator gets to the bottom of a 16-year-old murder case when he discovers the victim's body -- in the bottom of a well.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.sub-title: Killer on Campus / The Bow Hunter
programme.desc: Thirty-two years after the killing of University of Michigan law student Jane Mixer, police use DNA found on her pantyhose to finally track down the killer.

programme.desc: Dos hombres diferentes llamaron a la policía para denunciar el mismo asesinato. Al parecer, ninguno sabía que el otro había llamado. La investigación descubrió circunstancias aún más inusuales.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Evidencia del Jefe

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2007, el trailer de Effie y Michael Ratley en Florida se incendia y Michael heroicamente rescata a su esposa e hijo. Un mes después, su esposa es encontrada golpeada hasta la muerte en una habitación de la casa de sus padres.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Una fría noche de Diciembre de 1993, Rose Larner se detuvo en una tienda cuando se dirigía a la casa de su novio. Nunca más se la vio ni se supo de ella.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un asesino en serie andaba suelto y la policía tenía que encontrarlo antes de que atacara nuevamente. Su pista más prometedora era inusual: una huella dactilar sangrienta en el cuerpo de una de las víctimas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La escena del crimen era especialmente violenta: un esposo y una esposa fueron asesinados a tiros en su habitación. ¿Fue cómplice su hija de 16 años?

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2008, el desarrollador inmobiliario de Colorado, Alan Helmick, fue encontrado muerto a tiros en su casa por su esposa Miriam, quien luego se convirtió en la principal sospechosa.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: ¿Qué tan desafortunado puede ser un hombre? Su esposa se quitó la vida y su novia de la universidad se suicidó de la misma manera catorce años antes. Los investigadores tuvieron que determinar si esto era solo una extraña coincidencia o dos asesinatos.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando una joven fue encontrada muerta, la policía arrestó rápidamente al sospechoso más probable. Pero la tecnología de punta de la NASA permitió a un odontólogo forense demostrar que el hombre equivocado estaba tras las rejas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Viktorioso
programme.desc: Tres homicidios en dos continentes parecían ejecuciones profesionales. Los investigadores de ambos lados del Atlántico necesitaban averiguar si estaban relacionados.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Timothy Wilson Spencer fue identificado como el hombre que violó y estranguló a cinco jóvenes mujeres en Virginia. Con el uso de perfiles de ADN, se libera a un hombre inocente y se condena al verdadero asesino.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un caso inusual involucrando la violación y muerte de Nancy DePriest en 1988. Después de que Chris Ochoa confesara, el caso fue cerrado. 8 años después, Achim Marino confesó al mismo crimen.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Ataque biológico
programme.desc: El Ataque bio terrorista de Rajneeshee en 1984: los investigadores descubren un complot para derrocar al gobierno después de que una cepa única de salmonela enfermara a la gente.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1980, Shannon Mohr, residente de Michigan, murió en lo que su nuevo esposo, David Davis, reportó que fue un accidente al montar a caballo. Después de su muerte, la familia de Shannon informó que Davis parecía estar lejos de estar agobiado por el dolor.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: CSI

programme.title: CSI

programme.title: CSI

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: The team is introduced to the Furry side of Vegas when a man is found dead on the side of the road, dressed in a raccoon suit.

programme.title: CSI

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Warrick's appearance at the preliminary hearing on a rape and murder case goes terribly wrong when the only piece of evidence is thrown out on a technicality.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: A suspect's infatuation with Catherine results in her taking over a high-profile case.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: The sheriff is under political pressure to find who killed an air marshal with a car bomb that the sheriff witnessed.

programme.title: CSI en español

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Con potencialmente menos de un día para intentar evitar los próximos asesinatos, el equipo de CSI debe sacudirse rápidamente la sorpresa de que el verdadero asesino en miniatura no es el difunto Ernie Edward Dell.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: La ocurrencia de Grissom de que dos jóvenes amantes desaparecidos pueden haber huido a México queda pronto anulada por el descubrimiento de gotas de sangre junto a la plaza de aparcamiento libre del chico en el instituto.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Mientras procesa la casa donde fueron asesinadas varias coristas, Sara se ve atormentada por los ojos aterrorizados y las crípticas palabras moribundas de la sexta víctima que descubre.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Greg se ve obligado a enfrentarse de nuevo a la hostil madre y al hermano del matón al que mató en defensa propia hace varios meses cuando el equipo de CSI descubre que el hermano está implicado en un nuevo caso de asesinato.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Mientras Grissom y el resto de los CSI están fuera investigando nuevos casos, Hodges hace creer a Archie, Henry, Mandy y Wendy que Grissom quiere que se unan en secreto esa noche para intentar resolver los cuatro casos de asesinos en miniatura.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: En su intento por identificar al asesino de un ex boxeador que vivía entre un grupo de prostitutas que lo detestaban, los CSI deben establecer cuál de los varios actos que pusieron en peligro su vida en una noche realmente lo mató.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: El equipo de CSI investiga el asesinato de una crupier de blackjack cuyo marido, separado de ella, tiene vínculos con un club de creyentes en los ovnis.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.sub-title: El bueno, el feo y la dominatriz

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Mientras el equipo de CSI se acerca más que nunca a la identificación del asesino en miniatura, Sara desaparece misteriosamente, lo que obliga a sacar a la luz su relación con Grissom.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: El destino de Sara sigue siendo una incógnita mientras el equipo de CSI se apresura a averiguar si ha sobrevivido al ataque del asesino en miniatura, en el estreno de la octava temporada.

programme.title: CSI en español

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: El equipo de CSI investiga el asesinato de toda una familia, excepto el de una hija que supuestamente está poseída por el diablo.

Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain. A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Zero Hour 2
programme.desc: Since the late 1970s, the United States has been warming faster than the rest of the world. From heatwaves and coastal flooding in the Northeast to droughts and wildfires in the Southwest, things are looking bleak - but there’s still time. Today, students and scientists are working to mitigate - perhaps even reverse - the worst effects of climate change. The question is: can it be done?

Kenn Kington
programme.desc: Kenn Kington finds the funny in life's everyday moments—marriage quirks, parenting adventures, and roadwork woes. He turns real-life experiences into nonstop laughs. Get ready for a stand-up show full of heart and hilarity!

programme.title: Brad Bonar
programme.sub-title: The Comedy and Magic of Brad Bonar
programme.desc: Brad is a double threat. One of the most talented magicians in the country, he is also a very gifted and funny stand-up comedian. His wealth of material springs from his observations of family life, (Brad has four children). Brad's comedy is universal in its appeal, and along with the magic displayed in his show, he has become a favorite at every event he goes to. His magic shows the devious side of magician's life, messing with everyday people as they go about their business and giving them stories to tell for the rest of their lives. Brad also owns and operates Bonar Entertainment Group, a successful production company in Northern California. As an entertainer, Brad's job is to make as many friends as possible in a short amount of time. As a motivational speaker, he talks about the skills he has acquired over the years on how to make superficial friends and also on how to move beyond these types of friendships into deeper levels of trust and sharing with the people that we associate with on a daily basis. With more than 10 years of experience working with such clients as Bank of America, Coldwell Banker, Cope & McPhetres Marine, Evian Water, Hewlett Packard, MCI and many others, Brad Bonar offers a wide variety of services to enhance any entertainment event. Whether you need stand-up comedy, close-up magic, motivational speaking, a Master of Ceremonies or a corporate spokesperson, Brad's insight into what really makes an event entertaining and memorable is sure to have an impact on your audience.

programme.title: Tom Simmons: Peace, Love and Whatnot
Jamie Lissow
programme.desc: Actor and comedian Jamie Lissow is best known for his role in the current Netflix Original Series Real Rob, alongside SNL alum Rob Schneider, a show Jamie co-wrote and co-produced. Jamie made his network television debut on The Tonight Show and has since appeared on The Late Late Show, Last Comic Standing, Comedy Central's Premium Blend, Gotham Live, Star Search, and his own half-hour Comedy Central special. A headliner at comedy clubs across the country, he's also been featured at The Montreal Comedy Festival and The Great American Comedy Festival. Lissow has appeared on Fox News Redeye more than 50 times while still managing to have no political opinions.

programme.title: Adam Carolla
programme.desc: Outspoken podcast king and comedian Adam Carolla brings his unique humor to Dry Bar. He delivers his first clean act as he gets real about the absurdities of modern day parenting, unsuccessful rebrands, and what the rich and poor have in common.

programme.title: Chad Thornsberry
programme.desc: Chad Thornsberry was born in St. Louis, MO. From an early age he learned his family was blessed, and blessed him with humor, quick wit, and a love of storytelling. Chad's unique comedic perspective awards audience the opportunity to laugh at the common occurrences in everyday life. Often referred to as a great writer, his straightforward style allows audiences to laugh with him and at him as they find the humor in themselves. With reflections on growing up in a trailer park and observations as an English teacher, Chad's satiric insights look at the pitfalls that make us human. With smart humor and a conversational style, Chad has delighted audiences from the trailer park, throughout the Midwest, and from coast to coast.

programme.title: Rex Havens
programme.desc: Rex has been delighting comedy audiences for 20 years, in world-famous comedy clubs like The Improv, Catch-A-Rising Star, Funny Bones and Zanies, on television for Showtime, Comedy Central and Comic Relief, on radio with Bob & Tom and NPR, cruise ships worldwide, and corporate clients including GM, American Express, Texaco, 3M, Coca-Cola, IBM, Toshiba, Lowe's, Johnson & Johnson, Ameritech, Proctor & Gamble, State Farm, Quaker Oats, Verizon and the IRS (“Working for the IRS is the only sure way to get money from them.”), and numerous non-profit and charitable organizations, such as St. Jude's and the Make-A-Wish Foundation. A former college professor who made the unusual transition to the standup comedy stage in the '80's, Rex has always believed that laughter is the best defense against a confusing and challenging world. Rex's take on marriage and family has propelled him to performances in all 50 states and around the world, including London, Hong Kong, Amsterdam, Bermuda, Montreal, Barcelona, Copenhagen, Aruba, Rome and Cannes.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Drag Me To Glory
programme.desc: When NASCAR sensation Clint Bowyer pays a visit to the Duck Commander warehouse, Willie and the guys are fired up to spend the day hanging out with the professional racecar driver.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Duck Season Eve
programme.desc: Tomorrow is the opening day of Duck Season and the men are carrying on their tradition of camping on the Robertson Land the night before.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Can't Hardly Weight
programme.desc: Gearing up for his high school reunion, Willie realizes that he could stand to lose a few pounds. Jase and Korie set out to help him drop some weight and the strenuous battle of man-versus-waistline begins.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Shot Thru The Heart
programme.desc: The guys learn from Willie that John Luke is going through his first break up. In order to make him feel better the men decide to take John Luke hunting for nutria, and impart their relationship wisdom.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Here Lizard, Lizard
programme.desc: When the warehouse guys new office pet (a lizard) escapes, they try all they can in order to catch the wily reptile. Proving impossible, the guys finally decide to bring in the big guns to help trap it--Mr. Phil Robertson.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Hallu-Si-Nations
programme.desc: With Willie out-of-town, the guys decide to flake off work and leave to brush up the duck blinds on the Robertson land. While out, Si believes he spots what he thinks is the infamous 'Black Panther'.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Let's Go Hunting, Deer
programme.desc: Willie and Jase invite Korie and Missy along on a deer hunt because they believe their wives have become too "city." At Phil and Kay's, Miss Kay decides she wants to frame Phil's original blueprints from the first duck call he created.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Tickets To The Fun Show
programme.desc: During Duck Commander's "Casino Night" party, Si Robertson wins the grand prize of $2000 and decides to buy a massage chair for the duck call room. The massage chair becomes a detriment to the workflow, so Willie takes Si around for a replacement prize.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Duck Be a Lady
programme.desc: Sadie, has a homecoming dance coming up, but Willie doesn't approve of her dress selection. Willie decides to take Sadie out to find her a new "appropriate" dress.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Ring Around the Redneck
programme.desc: Though Jase lost his wedding ring long ago, Missy decides it's time for Jase to replace it with a new one. When Jase is duck hunting, once again, he loses the ring.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Bass Man Standing
programme.desc: The Duck Commander team is invited to unveil a wing of the local Bass Pro shop that will feature their products.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Battle of the Brothers
programme.desc: Willie's suspicious behavior from dyeing his beard to buying a new motorcycle, makes Jase come to the conclusion that Willie is having a mid-life crisis.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Aloha, Robertsons!
programme.desc: After all their hard work, Willie decides to take the entire Robertson clan on a family vacation to Hawaii. But Willie's daily itinerary for the trip gets constantly undermined by the family's desire to participate in their own island activities.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Till Duck Do Us Part
programme.desc: Everyone comes together to plan a surprise wedding for Phil and Kay, setting up a special ceremony on their land, which the whole family attends. Si distracts Phil and Kay by taking them on a "trip down memory lane".

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: So You Think You Can Date?
programme.sub-title: So You Think You Can Date?
programme.desc: After discovering that Martin has to miss a Friday night poker game for a date, the guys (as well as their wives) take turns figuring out the best way to coach him for romance. When babysitting for Jep and Jessica turns into a rocky road.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Hot Tub Grime Machine
programme.desc: The guys realize that Godwin has never really asked them for a favor, even though they are all always helping each other out. Godwin asks them to help him get a hot tub, so they set out to help him pick one up.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: A-Jase-ent Living
programme.desc: Due to construction at Jase and Missy's house, Willie and Korie invite Jase and the kids to live with them while Missy is out of town visiting friends. Then, what begins in the duck call room as a series of "Gentlemen's Bets".

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Termite Be a Problem
programme.desc: Because of a termite problem at Duck Commander, the guys are forced to find a different location to work from - Godwin's House. But while at Godwin's house, Godwin gets a taxidermied gift from a past relative.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: John Luke After Dentist
programme.desc: John Luke and Sadie are getting some dental work done, complete with sedation, and it's up to Willie and Korie to take care of them through the process - including getting them back home safely.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Scoot Along Si
programme.desc: Si shows up to work on a mobility scooter, claiming to have an invisible injury from a fender bender with Willie. After losing her beloved turtle "Mr. T", Ms. Kay enlists Phil on a mission to find a new pet turtle.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Jerky Boys
programme.desc: A decision to try and make some duck jerky leads the boys to Godwin's garage and a minibike race. Phil and Kay have made Willie the executor of their will, and Phil wants to show Willie what he and his brothers will inherit when he and Kay pass away.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Going Si-ral
programme.desc: Si discovers Youtube, and, after watching a series of instructional videos, decides he can make something better. John Luke totals Willie's truck, and Willie realizes he may be raising the two worst drivers in all of Louisiana.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Quack-O-Lantern
programme.desc: The Robertsons host a Halloween event at Duck Commander, where they all come together to transform the warehouse into a "scarehouse." Everyone dresses up and Willie desperately tries to be the scariest, but none of the kids are afraid of him.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: O Little Town of West Monroe
programme.sub-title: O Little Town of West Monroe
programme.desc: The Robertsons perform a live nativity for their Church for Christmas, so the wives organize rehearsals to ensure that they pull off a great event. However, rehearsals get off to a bumpy start as the guys can't stop sharing their opinions.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Boomerang Becca
programme.desc: When Rebecca returns home from her internship in Los Angeles, the Robertson family plans a big surprise party to welcome her back. Meanwhile, when Uncle Si gets sick, he seeks the help of Ms. Kay to take care of him.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Willie's Number Two
programme.desc: When Willie is looking to hire a new assistant, Korie insists he interviews her cousin, JD. Meanwhile, when Uncle Si spends the day over at Phil and Kay's, Jep stops by with the kids to keep them away from Jessica, who has taken ill.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Life of Si
programme.desc: After seeing footage Jep shot using a GoPro, Si decides he wants to use the camera to record a day in his life. But when Si gets on the guys nerves while they're hunting, they kick him and his GoPros out of the blind.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: From Duck 'til Dawn
programme.desc: When the duck guys have to pull an all-nighter to finish some work, Willie decides he wants to join them. But when a dying smoke detector distracts them from their work, Jase and Willie head off to disarm it.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Burger Commander
programme.desc: After visiting a popular burger restaurant, Willie and Jase get into a debate over which of them cooks the best burger, prompting them to challenge one another to a cooking contest.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: G.I. Si
programme.desc: When Willie and Jase argue over an old G.I. Joe toy, it leads them into a debate over who would make a better soldier. To settle the score, Willie and Jase head out to the woods with their friends and children for a paintball match.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Jase and the Argonauts
programme.desc: When Willie gets a soft serve machine for himself, he tells the guys they can't use it until they're done working. But when Jase thinks this is unfair, he takes matters into his own hands and finds a better object to use as motivation.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Fowl Playhouse
programme.desc: When Jase finds out Jep is planning to buy his kids a fancy playhouse from a catalogue, he and the guys decide to build one for Jep themselves. But the playhouse ends up looking more like a military-style duck blind.

programme.title: 2016 in Review - Abu Dhabi
programme.desc: The 2016 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix (formally known as the 2016 Formula 1 Etihad Airways Abu Dhabi Grand Prix) was a Formula One motor race held on 27 November 2016 at the Yas Marina Circuit in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. The race was the final round of the 2016 season and determined the 2016 World Drivers' Championship. It marked the eighth running of the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix and the eighth time that the race had been run as a World Championship event since the inaugural season in 1950.Defending race winner Nico Rosberg entered the round with a twelve-point lead over teammate Lewis Hamilton in the World Drivers' Championship. Their team, Mercedes, held a lead of two hundred and seventy-six points over Red Bull Racing in the World Constructors' Championship. Rosberg required a podium finish to secure the championship; Hamilton required a podium to remain in mathematical contention. Hamilton started the race from pole and went on to win the race, while Rosberg finished second, securing his maiden World Drivers' Championship title. Sebastian Vettel completed the podium in third.A week after the Grand Prix, Nico Rosberg announced his retirement from Formula One, making this Grand Prix his last.[3] This was also the last Grand Prix for the Manor team, as the team folded before the start of the 2017 season.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un pique, un show y un cuenco tibetano
programme.desc: Los vecinos de la comunidad descubrirán que el negocio que Enrique proyecta es un bar. Cuando éste les invite a la inauguración del local, la reacción de los vecinos será sumamente positiva, salvo la de los Recio, que decidirán introducir droga en la fiesta de apertura del establecimiento con el fin de que Enrique sea detenido y el local, clausurado. Sergio cumplirá un sueño que tiene desde niño: la posesión de un inmenso Scalextric. Sin embargo, la consecución de este anhelo entrañará cuantiosos problemas, ya que Joaquín acusará a su hermano de inmaduro. Además, el joven no encontrará el espacio necesario para instalarlo, por lo que pedirá permiso a Javi y Lola, sus vecinos de enfrente, para instalarlo en el rellano. La cena de parejas entre Amador y Maite y Javi y Lola en el ático B finalizará con el misterioso robo de un cuenco tibetano.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una póliza premium, un novio-tirita y un mayorista con el género a la vista
programme.desc: Gabi, amigo y antiguo compañero de la Universidad de Javi, regresará a Mirador de Montepinar, donde iniciará un romance con Judith. Cansada de encadenar un fracaso sentimental tras otro, la psicóloga comenzará a salir con el joven para tratar de enderezar su vida, mientras que él espera que ella lo quiera por sí mismo, motivo por el que le ocultará que es millonario. Entretanto, la reforma urgente para paliar los graves daños estructurales del inmueble obliga a todos los residentes a desalojarlo para acometer la obra. Durante la reparación, la aseguradora busca alojamiento a los vecinos en un hotel cercano, donde se relajarán más de la cuenta.

Decepcionado con la imposición paterna, el adolescente se refugia en casa de su madre y Reyes. Recuperar su vivienda a toda costa es el nuevo objetivo que se marca Antonio Recio y para lograrlo, intentará echar a Parrales haciéndole creer que Berta está poseída.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Paz (Melanie Olivares) tiene que trabajar para una persona de elevada reputación. Durante el servicio, el hombre fallece Ante esta dramática situación, Paz decide pedir ayuda a su amiga Aída (Carmen Machi) para deshacerse del cadáver. Cuando la policía (Fernando Guillén) investiga el caso, ellas, Mauricio (Mariano Peña), Chema (Pepe Viyuela), y Luisma (Paco León). Hasta ahora Luisma siempre le ha dejado a Mauricio ganar al naipes. Cuando el hostelero cree que es invencible, decide apostar su bar ante un buen jugador

programme.title: Aída
programme.sub-title: Mi madre se ha comido a mi compañero de piso
programme.desc: Aída (Carmen Machi) cumple 40 años y Paz (Melanie Olivares) la anima a que le dé un toque de alegría a su vida ya que su día a día resulta agobiante. Aída decide tomarse muy en serio el consejo y la protagonista da un cambio radical: va a clase de italiano, se centra en chicos que la distraen, cuida su aspecto Los problemas vienen cuando se aleja de su familia sin apenas darse cuenta. Eugenia (Marisol Ayuso) se va a vivir con Luisma (Paco León) y Barajas (Canco Rodríguez) y la convivencia no resulta agradable para los amigos. Mauricio (Mariano Peña) cae en la cuenta de que es extremadamente ignorante. Las burlas de Chema (Pepe Viyuela) y Luisma (Paco León) hacen que el hostelero se decida a sacarse el graduado escolar, pero esta tarea resulta más complicada de lo que parecía Además, Chema busca un regalo para Aída.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Aída (Carmen Machi) piensa que su hija Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa) está embarazada, y Paz (Melanie Olivares) se siente culpable Desde que comparte con Eugenia (Marisol Ayuso) sus sesiones de bingo, Mauricio (Mariano Peña) tiene suerte, así que está encantado de su compañía en el juego, pero Eugenia cree que sus intenciones son otras muy distintas. Jonathan (David Castillo) cumple trabajos sociales acompañando a pasear a un anciano. Su amigo Fidel (Eduardo Casanova) le apoya en la tarea. Chema (Pepe Viyuela) es consciente de que fue él quien le ofreció a Luisma (Paco León) su primer porro, y ahora piensa que por su culpa fue drogadicto. Dicho cargo de conciencia hará que Chema intente recompensarle por el daño hecho.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Mauricio (Mariano Peña) se presenta como candidato a la presidencia de la Junta de Distrito. Chema (Pepe Viyuela) le ayuda con la campaña, pero las sucias armas del hostelero para conseguir votos no concuerdan con la moral de su amigo. Aída (Carmen Machi) y los suyos acogen en su casa a Tang (Alberto Joo Lee), un estudiante chino, para sacar partido económico. La experiencia de Tang en casa de los García resulta ser indignante.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Los monarcas van a visitar el barrio, y los vecinos se preparan para la ocasión, pero Mauricio (Mariano Peña) se avergüenza de ellos y trata de hacer que no estén presentes durante la visita. Fidel (Eduardo Casanova) y Toni (Secun de la Rosa) preparan la obra Don Juan Tenorio para agasajar a los Reyes de España. Con la insistencia de Fidel para que Jonathan (David Castillo) represente el papel de Juan, quedan claros ya sus sentimientos. Tras su relación con Aída, Chema (Pepe Viyuela) tiene una cita con una chica bastante tonta. Mauricio y Luisma (Paco León) se mofan de él.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Mauricio (Mariano Peña) se encuentra disfrutando de los servicios de un prostíbulo cuando la policía aparece en el local y decide cerrar el negocio. Las prostitutas no tienen papeles así que Mauricio decide acogerlas y Chema (Pepe Viyuela) apoya la solidaridad de su amigo dándoles clases a las chicas para que obtengan el graduado escolar y se ganen la vida de otra manera. Todo parece estar en órden hasta que el proxeneta llega para reclamar a las chicas Luisma (Paco León) y Barajas (Canco Rodríguez) se alarman cuando los medios anuncian el fin del mundo. Y a pesar de que Chema les asegura que se trata de una información incorrecta, los dos amigos están dispuestos a comprobar cuánto de verdad hay en ella. Tras conocer por casualidad a Omar (Younes Bachir) y descubrir que debido a su religión, el chico no puede mantener relaciones sexuales hasta el matrimonio, Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa) decide dejarlo. Sin embargo, cuando la hija mediana de Aída cree que el joven musulmán es hijo de un poderoso hombre del petróleo cambia de idea ¿Cómo acabará esta relación?

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una secesión, una sub-piña y superchochete contra el capitán Salami
programme.desc: Un nuevo paciente acaparará la atención y el interés de Judith. Gonzalo, un apuesto viudo, requerirá sus servicios como terapeuta para que le ayude a sobrellevar la trágica muerte de su esposa. Por otra parte, Teodoro encuentra en un armario el disfraz del capitán Salami de su hermano. El menor de los Rivas propone a Amador crear una webserie para narrar sus aventuras y triunfar así en el entorno online. Entretanto, Raluka Petrescu, la exmujer de Fermín, regresa a Mirador de Montepinar, donde dará una inesperada sorpresa al padre de Lola. Consciente de que la labor presidencial de su padre está siendo un desastre, Javi recomienda a Vicente y Fermín que contraten los servicios de un administrador de fincas. Sin embargo, las rigurosas medidas anti-morosidad que implementa el nuevo gestor originan un grave conflicto entre los vecinos

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una yaya por sorpresa, una vasectomía y la gran orquesta de Montepinar
programme.desc: La curiosidad innata y un carácter polifacético son las señas de identidad de Héctor (William Miller), rasgos que le han impulsado a abordar diversas disciplinas artísticas. El talento, creatividad y magnetismo de este prometedor artista multidisciplinar es interés de Maite Figueroa, que triunfa como escritora de novela erótica y que desea disfrutar plenamente de sus últimos años de atractivo. Tras su primer encuentro, ambos vivirán un tórrido romance. Entretanto, Yolanda volcará su energía en formar su propia familia, ya que está firmemente convencida de que ha llegado la hora de convertirse en madre, situación que sobrepasa a Amador, padre de tres hijos. Asesorado por los 'leones', el Cuqui se plantea someterse en secreto a una vasectomía. Por otra parte, Vicente, cansado de las continuas presiones de Fermín, decide quitárselo de encima llamando a un programa de televisión para que localicen a Estela Reynolds.

programme.title: El Pueblo
programme.desc: Imanol Mendieta, un reputado cineasta, acude a Peñafría como paciente a la clínica de desintoxicación de Juanjo, que aprovecha la ocasión para convencer a Amaya de que regrese al pueblo. Mientras, el nerviosismo se apodera de Cándido y Arsacio por distintos motivos: al alcalde del municipio lo han elegido para dar un discurso en una importante convención sobre la España vaciada y Arsacio, consciente de que su relación con Damarys va avanzando, teme la llegada del momento de intimar con ella. Para calmarse y estilizar su físico, ambos deciden apuntarse a un gimnasio junto a El Ovejas. Además, a medida que nuevos negocios se ponen en marcha en Peñafría, Nacho descubre las dificultades y peligros que conlleva trabajar para el implacable Tío Filetes. Tras darse cuenta de que apenas disfrutó de su juventud, Laura decide recuperar esta etapa, saliendo de fiesta con Balbina.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un reencuentro, un desalojo y un torneo de paddle
programme.desc: Izaskun y Mari Tere, ocultas en el cuarto de basuras, esperan a que Raquel, Joaquín y Eric concluyan su jornada de trabajo para acceder al piso piloto y pasar allí la noche. Cuando constatan que ya no queda nadie en la vivienda, se introducen en ella. Sin embargo, las dos okupas ignoran que los empleados de la compañía se han entretenido charlando en la puerta de entrada. Raquel se percata entonces de que las dos ancianas se encuentran dentro de la casa y les exige que la abandonen. Ante la negativa de ambas mujeres, la directora comercial llama a la policía y las amigas dejan de ser okupas nocturnas para serlo a jornada completa. Para poder seguir vendiendo la segunda fase del ''Mirador de Montepinar'' sin problemas, Raquel, Joaquín y Eric llevan a cabo distintas iniciativas para que Izaskun y Mari Tere cambien su lugar de residencia.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Mentiras, antidepresivos y una nevera de Troya
programme.desc: Enrique sufre una profunda depresión, situación por la que rompe a llorar frecuentemente y sin motivo. Preocupada por el deplorable estado anímico de su esposo, Araceli intenta animarle, pero nada parece consolarle. Al ver que los esfuerzos de su hija son infructuosos, Doña Charo receta a su suegro unas pastillas ''milagrosas'' que le animan sobremanera. Inesperadamente, Enrique hace público su deseo de presentar su candidatura a la presidencia de la urbanización.

programme.title: 13 Horas: Los soldados secretos de Bengasi
programme.desc: En el aniversario de los ataques del 11 de septiembre, en 2012, un grupo de terroristas llevó a cabo un ataque contra el consulado estadounidense y una base de la CIA en Bengasi, Libia. En respuesta, un equipo de seis operativos de las Fuerzas Especiales de Estados Unidos fue desplegado para rescatar a los supervivientes.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una mentira, un bar de ambiente y una bestia...
programme.desc: Los problemas generados por la apertura del local de Enrique continuarán. En esta ocasión, el descubrimiento de la inexistencia de la licencia pertinente llevará a la comunidad a denunciarlo. El propietario del local intentará hacer valer su amistad con el concejal de Urbanismo desconociendo que, mientras tanto, Maxi transformará el local en un exitoso bar de ambiente. Javi desconfiará de la confesión de su esposa, que le explicará que el odio entre ella y su suegra es mutuo. Para demostrarle la veracidad de tal revelación, Lola tramará un plan: anunciará la separación de su marido para apreciar la felicidad de su suegra. Sin embargo, la noticia desatará unas consecuencias insospechadas: los vecinos asegurarán intuir la ruptura, Amador y Maite intentarán comprar el ático y Leo tratará de seducir a Lola. Joaquín continuará en paro, lo que le sumirá en una profunda crisis existencial. Para intentar solucionarlo, pedirá a su hermano que le consiga algún papel en la serie en la que éste trabaja. El comportamiento de los Recio incomodará a Raquel, su inquilina, que, ante esta situación, decidirá compartir piso con Blanca, una compañera del gimnasio recién separada.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una ruina en venta, unas elecciones explosivas y un campamento de refugiados
programme.desc: Gabi sorprende a Judith Becker y le pide matrimonio. Mientras tanto, el edificio de 'Mirador de Montepinar' es precintado por los bomberos. Fermín pretende vender pisos en ruina baratos para evitar caer en la indigencia. Yolanda quiere que Amador vaya a vivir a su casa para conocer al resto de la familia Morcillo.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una tubería podrida, un chatarrero conceptual y...
programme.desc: Llega a Montepinar Rebeca, abogada matrimonialista amiga de Judith que pondrá en serio peligro los matrimonios de Antonio Recio y Enrique Pastor. Enrique, por cierto, se convertirá en el sexto presidente del inmueble. En "Una tubería podrida, un chatarrero conceptual y el primer montepinario puro", primer episodio de la séptima temporada, veremos la nueva situación de Estela Reinolds, que ha encontrado una vida acomodada al fin con Fermín. Por su parte, Lola y Judith se estrenarán como madres y la vida se pondrá difícil para los Cuquis, cuya precaria situación económica les convertirá en un familia en riesgo de exclusión social.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A woman was brutally murdered in her home and the only witnesses to the crime were the family dogs. An expert in canine behavior was convinced the killer knew both the victim and the animals, and he was determined find out what the dogs had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When convenience store employee Wanda Mason is found dead, investigators find the entire murder has been caught on the store's security camera. But the image of the killer is so degraded it seems impossible to positively identify him.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1996, police received a call from Darlie Routier telling them of her two sons' murders. The police found the killer by analyzing blood spatter, doing behavioral profiling and analyzing Darlie's 911 call.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A serial arsonist starts several fires that cause millions of dollars worth of damage and the deaths of three people. He is discovered, partly through the use of forensic hypnosis.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Casino security cameras tracked a young woman's movements until shortly before she disappeared. She was never seen again, but through the evidence she left behind, she was able to tell investigators what happened to her and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Investigators are baffled after finding a murder scene devoid of any physical evidence, but they suspect that the victim's dog had witnessed the crime. If so, forensic scientists would have to find some way to learn what the dog had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Women in a Louisiana city live in fear of a rapist who leaves no clues to his identity. But technology and behavioral science combine to give police a new forensic tool. Police narrow their search to one man: local policeman Randy Comeaux.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Firefighters find an entire family dead inside their home in an apparent murder-suicide, but there are several inconsistent clues in the rubble. Could ballistics, a time card and some secret audiotapes unravel the mystery?

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 2004, Mary Ann Clibbery was found brutally murdered at her Illinois business. Investigators had to determine if this was a robbery gone wrong or a calculated murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Authorities track a kidnapper who let his victim write a last will and informed the family of her murder. A phone number written on a previous page left a lasting impression, which helped to convict.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Two eyewitnesses may hold the key to the death of a motorcycle gang member.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Just weeks before a witness is to testify against the man accused of sexually assaulting her, she is murdered in the front yard of her own home. Investigators immediately suspect her attacker, but they don't have enough evidence to prove his guilt.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: One investigator's quick thinking helps him capture a shoe impression made in snow before the evidence melts away. The shoe leads investigators to Peter Benedict and Frank Lanoue, who are convicted of aggravated assault and robbery.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 2000, teenager Tara Munsey went missing after a work shift at a Virginia restaurant. Did she run away, or was she the victim of foul play?

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Mark Fair left for work and his fiancée, Karla Brown, stayed home. Later, he found her dead. During the autopsy, bite marks on her body were re-examined and forensic odontology identified the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.desc: Susie Mowbray was charged in her husband's death. Her son was so convinced of her innocence that he enrolled in law school, studied all of the evidence and, eventually, discovered the truth of what really happened between his parents.

programme.desc: A woman disappears and her husband becomes the prime suspect — especially after police find a huge bloodstain on the carpet of their bedroom. When they spray the bedroom with Luminol, they discover it was awash with blood spatter.

programme.title: The Benefits of Red Light Therapy | Esencia: Latina Wellness
programme.desc: Katherine Castro talks with Bill Wiederman about what red light therapy is, how it works, and whether it’s worth using. They clear up common myths and explain what actually matters when choosing a device.

programme.title: Legacies and New Traditions with Lupita Infante | Cultura Shock
